scope_excerpt.text: This PCR covers complete manufacture of bare uninstalled flat cellulose-fibre cement board from purchased Portland cement, prepared cellulose pulp, quartz-rich sand and every actually used separate supply, through first quality release, with subsequent observed packing/storage/handling/dispatch recorded as a separate service account. The selected route is pulp dispersion/refining and actual sand preparation → dosing/slurry mixing → Hatschek sieve/felt/format-roll forming and dewatering → green cutting/stacking/pressing → documented precuring → steam autoclaving → cooling/de-stacking → actual drying/final trim and tests → first release. It is a transparent technical synthesis of manufacturer and certification evidence, not an asserted same-SKU, same-plant recipe or contemporary order. bba-superflex-2019; uac-fibre-cement-2024; iibcc-cutting-2010; swisspearl-manufacture.

Cellulose pulp means discrete prepared plant fibres, not wood chips or wood wool. Cellulose is the only reinforcing fibre in this selected method; a real polymer retention aid is a separately supplied preparation, not automatically a reinforcing fibre. Exclude asbestos, PVA/glass/basalt or other reinforcement, gypsum matrices, resin/wood-particle agglomerates, corrugated/moulded roofing, patterned or coated boards, externally faced/laminated boards, composites with dissimilar layers and installed roof/wall systems. Those require a distinct applicability decision. Same-formulation thin-layer accumulation inherent in Hatschek forming remains included; it is not the excluded dissimilar-layer composite. Cement manufacture is upstream, not whole-board manufacture. No formulation, fibre share, water/cement ratio, curing temperature/time, strength, density, operating recipe, installation test threshold or service life is prescribed. The declared unit is manufacturing supply, not proven installed performance.

本PCR覆盖从外购硅酸盐水泥、已制备纤维素纸浆、富石英硅砂及每种实际使用的单独供货开始，制造未安装裸纤维素纤维水泥平板至首次质量放行的完整过程；后续观测到的包装、储存、搬运、发运另列服务账。选定路线为纸浆分散精磨及实际硅砂制备→计量浆料配混→Hatschek圆网/毛毯/成形辊成形脱水→湿切、堆垛压制→有记录预养→蒸汽蒸压→冷却脱垛→真实干燥、终修边和试验→首次放行。这是制造商及认证证据的透明技术综合，不宣称同SKU、同工厂配方或当代订单。bba-superflex-2019; uac-fibre-cement-2024; iibcc-cutting-2010; swisspearl-manufacture。

纤维素纸浆指已制备的分散植物纤维，不是木屑或木丝。本选定方法仅以纤维素为增强纤维；真实聚合物助留剂为单独供货制剂，不自动属于增强纤维。排除石棉、PVA、玻璃、玄武岩或其他增强纤维、石膏基体、树脂木粒胶结物、波形模制屋面、压纹或涂覆板、外覆面或另加层压面层的板、由不同材料层组成的复合板及已安装屋面墙系统，须另作适用性决定。Hatschek成形固有的同配方薄层叠积仍在范围内，不属于上述排除的异材层复合结构。水泥制造属于上游，不是整板制造。不规定配方、纤维份额、水灰比、养护温时、强度、密度、制造操作配方、安装试验阈值或寿命。声明单位表示制造供货，不证明安装性能。
